sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Your on-time delivery averaged 82.5% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70740@2026Q3, sc:70740@2026Q2, sc:70740@2026Q1, sc:70740@2025Q4).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 5.84 per unit (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We can agree to a 24-month contract, but we must include the AS-14404 index clause as we cannot offer fixed pricing for this duration.

Our main Angebot is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

By maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we are able to offer a highly competitive price of EUR 5.60 per unit. As an alternative option, we can offer a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

We have received your updated term sheets and appreciate your flexibility. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your movement, we can reduce our price to EUR 5.50 per unit, provided we agree on 30-day payment terms, a 24-month contract, and the AS-14404 index clause. This is a substantial step from our side, reflecting our commitment to finding a mutually beneficial agreement.

To confirm the details of our Angebot, we are pleased to present a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for reaching out to us. We appreciate your updated offer, although the adjustment is quite small. It is always a pleasure working with you, and we remain fully committed to supporting your business with our extensive material range and dependable distribution service.

To accommodate your request for 90-day payment terms, we can lower our price to EUR 5.60 per unit, which comes with a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Our previous offer of EUR 5.50 per unit remains available should you prefer 30-day payment terms. As a reminder, this proposal comprises a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
